dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Significant 2D geometric narrowing of the body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the lower edge of the frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with high median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, localized patches of light-grey pixels distributed across the mid and lower-right dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the faint grey pigmented clusters and the white baseline surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Several small, high-contrast white circular marks distributed across the dorsal plane, most notably on the upper-left side.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent longitudinal, linear structural indentation or ridge extending along the central-right posterior dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct longitudinal linear scar or healed indentation visible on the posterior dorsal region.
